digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Thursday, October 8 has four live meetings, one protected work block, ten carried-over actions, and five urgent items. Start with the 10:30 AM Amazon Connect standup: Denver is targeting an October 13 go-live after Monday testing, but the full skills, skill-level, and user inputs are still incomplete. The 2:30 PM Attorney Review check-in is the day's main decision point; ELT still needs to choose the review path and confirm whether the launch remains October 15 or moves to October 19. Also address the emerging Legal-capacity risk for EKM scripts before it begins delaying Agentforce readiness. Dashboard completion state last updated Monday morning, so the carry-over list may include work completed since then.

items.label: Lock the Amazon Connect inputs and Denver launch controls
items.detail: Denver testing is planned for October 12 with go-live on October 13, but the complete users, skills, skill levels, language values, and deployment ownership remain unresolved. Use the 10:30 AM standup to name authoritative files, owners, deadlines, and coverage for Jacob's PTO next week.

items.label: Force the Attorney Review path and launch-date decision
items.detail: The group leans toward reviewing only after a client commits, which cuts expected attorney reviews from about 170 to 35 per day, but ELT has not signed off. At 2:30 PM, close Path A versus Path B, October 15 versus October 19, no-help handling, approval validity, and script timing language.

items.label: Convert stalled portfolio dependencies into decisions
items.detail: Use today's leadership touchpoints and weekly team meeting to give each material Legal, IT Security, or ELT dependency a decision owner and date, or recommend an explicit hold instead of allowing the same blockage to repeat.

items.label: Confirm the NTA SMS production result and release ready work
items.detail: Verify whether the business-hours production test succeeded and whether the NTA communication deployment moved forward. Keep the production-ready CoE request independent if any SMS follow-up remains.

items.label: Close the Legal Request Tool notification gap
items.detail: Confirm whether the incomplete live-tool email was a configuration issue or expected behavior, and route a defect through the Halo support path if the notification is still missing required information.

items.label: Plan the five downward reviews
items.detail: All five reviews are due October 15. Reserve writing time this week and collect prior-manager input where required so the final reviews reflect both managers' feedback.

items.label: Resolve the overdue Q3 Legacy Award nomination
items.detail: The nomination deadline passed Monday and the task remains open in dashboard state. Verify submission now; if it was missed, contact the program owner immediately to confirm whether a late entry is possible.

items.label: Confirm Monday's timecards and approvals are clear
items.detail: The approval task remains unchecked. Verify payroll approvals are complete and resolve any exceptions before the week closes.

items.label: Decide Skye Austin's document edit requests
items.detail: Review the four requests for the VAWA AOS, Asylum, Naturalization, and I-751 case decks, confirm the appropriate permission level, and approve or decline them together.

items.label: Complete the overdue harassment-prevention training
items.detail: Rippling continues to flag the Dominican Republic EOR course, overdue since December 9, 2025. Complete it or confirm with HR why it remains assigned.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Amazon Connect daily standup
items.detail: Confirm the Denver test and October 13 go-live controls, close the incomplete users and skills data, and assign PTO coverage for next week's deployment work.

items.label: 11:30 AM - Armando 1:1
items.detail: Use the one-on-one to clear delivery ownership or capacity questions that need resolution before the afternoon meetings.

items.label: Noon - Protected work block
items.detail: Use the hour for the overdue approvals, Legal-capacity alignment, and preparation for the Attorney Review decision.

items.label: 2:30 PM - Attorney Review progress check-in
items.detail: Secure the ELT path decision, launch date, script direction, and remaining owner commitments before the October 15 target gets any closer.

items.label: 4:00 PM - Tudo Bem weekly meeting
items.detail: Carry forward only the highest-impact roadblocks, including Product prioritization, Amazon Connect readiness, and any unresolved portfolio decisions.

items.label: Secure Legal review capacity for EKM scripts
items.detail: Nicolas flagged that a growing batch of scripts needs Legal review and could block both the EKM migration and Agentforce configuration, testing, and use-case validation. Align with Sara and Legal on the review owner, capacity, and prioritization before the queue expands.

items.label: Set the weekly CoE and Product touchpoint
items.detail: The October 6 alignment assigned Jean the recurring Tuesday touchpoint before 5:00 PM ET. Put the cadence on the calendar so the 31-request backlog, including 11 already awaiting a sprint, has a consistent prioritization forum.

items.label: Triage the newly assigned intake work
items.detail: Review the Universal Intake Questions revamp and Do Not Contact Banners requests assigned by Jorge, along with today's Asana summary, and decide the next owner, priority, and first follow-up for each.

items.label: Decide Tomas Aparicio's SOP access request
items.detail: Tomas requested access to the SOP FP Received document. Confirm the appropriate permission level, then approve or decline the SharePoint request.

items.label: Sara is out through October 12
items.detail: Route time-sensitive leadership approvals and escalations through available coverage today and Friday.

items.label: Laura begins PTO Friday
items.detail: Her calendar shows PTO through October 16. Close or reassign any dependency that cannot wait until she returns.

items.label: 9:30 AM - Amazon Connect standup
items.detail: Use the checkpoint to confirm readiness for Monday's Denver testing and the October 13 go-live.

items.label: 1:00-3:30 PM - EPMO, pipeline, and executive-slide sequence
items.detail: The afternoon is compressed: management at 1:00 PM, pipeline at 2:30 PM, then the executive slide update at 3:00 PM. Enter with decisions and status changes already distilled.

items.label: 4:30 PM - USCIS Form Changes scoping call
items.detail: Prepare to decide whether Phase I, Business Development, or a split model owns the future process, and identify the Legal, communication, DocuSign, training, and downstream dependencies.
